# Perch

> Deploy a Hummingbot strategy. We run the hands. You never log in.

Point Condor (or another agent) at hummingbot-api on a sealed Act plane. Inventory sits in a vault PDA because Perch operates the crank — that lock is the trust model, not a second product. After a tape exists, the curator can keep a fee from people who opt in. Perch never holds inventory.

Site: https://perch.poroburu.com
Docs: https://perch.poroburu.com/docs
Demo tape: https://perch.poroburu.com/tape
Memo: https://github.com/perch-hq/f26-perch/blob/main/PERCH.md
Architecture: https://github.com/perch-hq/f26-perch/blob/main/ARCH.md
Strategy: https://github.com/perch-hq/f26-perch/blob/main/STRATEGY.md

## Product

- One job: deploy a Hummingbot strategy without sysadmin or Toronto slot-lag.
- Vault PDA is the trust lock (cannot Transfer out except the named fee skim). freeze kills act. Anyone with a Deposit withdraws without us.
- Curator's own Deposit ticks first. Opt-in LP / fee-from-friends is upside after a tape, not a peer SKU.
- Seat rent covers colo. When a vault performs, Perch may share claimed venue fees (named on-chain) and waive rent.
- First venue is Meteora DLMM — a VaultKind adapter, not the company.
- Sealed seat in Amsterdam or Frankfurt. Tenant never gets a login.
- Packaged lp_rebalancer this sprint. No arbitrary .py on the Act box.

## Not this

- Not a Kamino. Perch is not the pooled manager. No APY/TVL catalog.
- Not a managed VPS with SSH and a Stripe hold. Not “hosted Condor.”
- Not Jump-competitive HFT. Not a SWQoS marketplace.
- Not a fund. Opt-in capital is the curator's job.

## Agent tools (this sprint)

Discover this file. Drive the cheap-plane API; never hold the crank or an owner key.

- `open_lease` / `open_vault` / `allow_lp` — curator wallet signs
- `join` / `fund` / `withdraw` — LP wallet signs
- `start_lp_rebalancer` / `patch_rebalancer` — packaged controller only
- `freeze` — curator or operator, not LP
- `lease_status` / `landing_receipts` — read-only

Refuse: paste private key, SSH, upload controller `.py`, swaps, slash, live fee changes.
